SELECT s.id, s.location_id, l.name AS location_name, s.description, s.shot_at, s.status, s.review_reason, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission_asset count_asset WHERE count_asset.submission_id = s.id ) AS asset_count, ( SELECT cover_asset.object_key FROM submission_asset cover_asset WHERE cover_asset.submission_id = s.id ORDER BY cover_asset.sort_order, cover_asset.id LIMIT 1 ) AS cover_key, s.submitted_at, s.updated_at FROM submission s LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id = s.location_id
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission s INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = s.user_id

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(u.name, ''), u.cas_id, CONCAT('用户', u.id)) AS uploader_name, s.location_id, l.name AS location_name, s.description, s.shot_at, s.tags, s.status, s.review_reason, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission_asset count_asset WHERE count_asset.submission_id = s.id ) AS asset_count, ( SELECT cover_asset.object_key FROM submission_asset cover_asset WHERE cover_asset.submission_id = s.id ORDER BY cover_asset.sort_order, cover_asset.id LIMIT 1 ) AS cover_key, s.submitted_at, s.reviewed_at, s.updated_at, s.version FROM submission s INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id = s.location_id
ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC, s.id DESC
ORDER BY s.submitted_at ASC, s.id ASC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, u.cas_id AS uploader_cas_id, u.name AS uploader_name, u.nickname AS uploader_nickname, u.avatar_key AS uploader_avatar_key, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission user_submission WHERE user_submission.user_id = s.user_id AND user_submission.deleted = 0 ) AS uploader_submission_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission approved_submission WHERE approved_submission.user_id = s.user_id AND approved_submission.deleted = 0 AND approved_submission.status = 1 ) AS uploader_approved_count, s.location_id, l.name AS location_name, s.description, s.shot_at, s.tags, s.status, s.review_reason, s.submitted_at, s.reviewed_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(reviewer.nickname, ''), NULLIF(reviewer.name, ''), reviewer.cas_id) AS reviewer_name, s.reviewed_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.version FROM submission s INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id = s.location_id LEFT JOIN `user` reviewer ON reviewer.id = s.reviewed_by WHERE s.id = #{submissionId} AND s.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE submission SET status = #{afterStatus}, review_reason = #{reviewReason}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = #{reviewedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{submissionId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{beforeStatus} AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE submission SET status = #{afterStatus}, review_reason = NULL, reviewed_by = NULL, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, updated_at = #{submittedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{submissionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 2 AND version = #{expectedVersion}
